experiment: isolated slider; timestep-scaled joint-limit solref comparison
limit_comparison: For each timestep, compare MuJoCo defaults with requested solreflimit=[2*timestep_s, 1]. Verify the compiled value and refsafe flag.
sampling_note: Every integration step is recorded. time_s labels post-step position/velocity; solver_evaluation_time_s labels pre-integration acceleration, gravity and constraint force. Spring force is computed from post-step position. Do not combine these fields as a simultaneous force balance.
limitations: The diagnostic generalized force is not a finger model. Spring/damping values are provisional; this remains an isolated slider test.
